subject: general
question: Which ministry introduced the Drugs and Cosmetics (Compounding of Offences) Rules, 2025, to streamline minor offence resolution?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare introduced the Drugs and Cosmetics (Compounding of Offences) Rules, 2025, to streamline the resolution of minor offences under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.
 
• These rules aim to reduce litigation and encourage the compounding of minor offences, thereby ensuring quicker and more efficient justice delivery.
 
• The compounding mechanism offers an alternative to prosecution for certain offences, which helps decongest courts and enables better regulatory compliance.
 
• The initiative reflects the government's focus on modernizing drug regulatory frameworks to align with global standards.
 
• By implementing these rules, the Ministry intends to enhance transparency, efficiency, and accountability within the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers:**

 
 
• This ministry primarily oversees the production, distribution, and pricing of fertilizers and chemicals in India.
 
• It has three departments: Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals, Department of Fertilizers, and Department of Pharmaceuticals.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution:**
 
 
• This ministry focuses on consumer rights, food security, and public distribution systems in India.
 
• It implements policies like the National Food Security Act and regulates essential commodities.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Pharmaceuticals:**
 
 
• This ministry is a part of the Department of Chemicals and Fertilizers and focuses on the growth of the pharmaceutical sector.
 
• It promotes the availability of affordable medicines and oversees the development of the pharmaceutical industry.
